## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a regression test that fails without the fix
- [ ] User-visible changes have an entry under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Behavior that existing projects rely on is unchanged, or the change is listed under "Breaking changes"
- [ ] The pull request title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
